properties.answer: BUILD IT SECOND. Anthony, 2026-09-11: "go with your suggested order". The server-guaranteed export follows the release binary because it removes a whole class of loss (the forgotten export) and makes the one-export-per-PR rule automatic instead of remembered. The four details the rulings left open — debounce interval, the git query that finds main's version, the hand-edited working-tree export, and the no-git fallback — are settled inside the increment, not before it.
